People: Sarah Scott (author, Wikidata Q7422765), died 1795. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Scott, Sarah, 1723-1795") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: A description of Millenium Hall, and the country adjacent: together with the characters of the inhabitants, and such historical anecdotes and reflections, as may excite in the reader proper sentiments of humanity, ... By a gentleman on his travels.  , 1762, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/bim_eighteenth-century_a-description-of-milleni_gentleman-on-his-travels_1762. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 64%, 65%, 85% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Sarah Scott, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
